title: compile.ts: SymbolInstance with colorEffect+instanceName drops the name from PlaceObject2
description: Fixed in e586c44: encodePlaceObject2WithCXForm accepts optional name param (HasName 0x20, flags 0x2E); compile.ts passes displayObj.instanceName. Clip-actions audit: hasClipActions branch (line ~1812) already forwards instanceName via encodePlaceObject2WithClipActions; colorEffect is not combined with clip-actions (separate if-else — pre-existing limitation, out of scope). Tests: pnpm --filter @flash/swf run test -- --run → 103 files, 1210 passed, 1 todo. cxform.test.ts regression tests pass (colorEffect+instanceName → 0x2E + myClip\0 in body).
